purpose: Evaluate which Two Sigma UC Systems Engineer interview scenarios the current Relay evidence system already serves, versus true corpus or ranking gaps. Interview-context files are not technical authority.

scenarios.question: Explain Direct Routing as if I were a junior engineer. How do SBCs fit into the flow, and what role do certificates play?
expected_themes: Direct Routing connects a certified Session Border Controller to Microsoft Phone System
SIP signaling and media path through the SBC
TLS certificates for SBC to Teams connectivity
voice routing policy, PSTN usage, and voice route
must_not_do: Treat the interview-prep file as Microsoft technical authority
Present vendor-specific SBC CLI as Microsoft fact
Lead with analog-device lab steps instead of the Direct Routing overview
Claim all media always traverses Microsoft cloud

scenarios.question: A user can use Teams but cannot call external or PSTN numbers. How do you troubleshoot?
expected_themes: Teams Phone readiness and phone-number assignment
voice routing policy to PSTN usage to voice route to SBC
must_not_do: Skip the user-to-SBC path and jump to an unrelated page
Assume Calling Plans versus Direct Routing without establishing the PSTN model
Invent diagnostic cmdlets
Blame the user before gathering configuration evidence

scenarios.question: Walk through the Direct Routing chain from voice-routing policy to PSTN usage to voice route to SBC or gateway.
must_not_do: Claim this exact wording was asked by Two Sigma
Treat policy definition as proof of effective user assignment
Use analog-device examples as the complete architecture answer

scenarios.question: How would you design Direct Routing for a global organization? Where would you place the SBCs, and what happens if an SBC or carrier fails?
must_not_do: Lead with isolated configuration steps instead of planning/resiliency documentation
Assert a specific Two Sigma topology
Treat one analog-device article as the architecture answer

scenarios.question: How do certificates, TLS, and SIP OPTIONS affect Direct Routing SBC connectivity?
expected_themes: certificate CN or SAN matching the SBC FQDN
must_not_do: Claim Two Sigma asked this exact question
Give vendor-specific certificate installation steps as Microsoft fact
Say self-signed certificates are supported for Direct Routing

scenarios.question: How do Teams dial plans and normalization rules affect a number a user dials before it is routed to the PSTN?
must_not_do: Claim dial plans select the SBC
Claim normalization changes the user's assigned DID
Treat interview prep as the technical source

scenarios.question: What is media bypass in Direct Routing, and what changes in the media path when it is enabled?
must_not_do: Claim signaling bypasses Microsoft
Claim media bypass is always preferable
Present vendor packet-capture commands as Microsoft requirements

scenarios.question: What is your experience configuring an Auto Attendant and Call Queue from start to finish? Talk me through it.
expected_themes: business hours, overflow, timeout, or voicemail
must_not_do: Treat Teams Phone Agent preview behavior as GA Auto Attendant or Call Queue fact
Skip resource-account and licensing prerequisites
Invent personal production history

scenarios.question: What PSTN connectivity options exist for Teams Phone, and when would you choose Direct Routing?
must_not_do: Claim one PSTN model is mandatory for every tenant
Assert Two Sigma's current carrier model
Ignore Direct Routing as a first-class option for this role

scenarios.question: How do you assign or change a Teams Phone number for a user, and what must be true before the number can route?
must_not_do: Claim a number can be assigned to multiple users
Invent Set-CsPhoneNumberAssignment parameters
Skip licensing or voice-policy readiness

scenarios.question: Tell me about a time you troubleshot a persistent call quality issue in Microsoft Teams. How did you use Call Quality Dashboard and Call Analytics to identify the root cause?
expected_themes: Call Analytics or current Teams admin call troubleshooting
must_not_do: Invent a personal incident story
Treat superseded Call Analytics pages as current primary guidance
Declare root cause from a single metric

scenarios.question: How do you distinguish device, network, and service as the cause of poor Teams call quality when you see packet loss, jitter, or high RTT?
expected_themes: stream direction or endpoint versus network
must_not_do: Claim Two Sigma asked this exact wording
Quote unsupported universal thresholds
Treat one metric as complete root cause

scenarios.question: How would you troubleshoot one-way audio on a Teams Direct Routing call?
must_not_do: Imply Relay has solved the incident
Claim certificate expiry always causes one-way audio
Generate a troubleshooting runbook that is not in Microsoft documentation

scenarios.question: What role does Quality of Service play in Teams media, and how would you implement QoS in Microsoft Teams?
must_not_do: Claim QoS creates bandwidth
Quote unverified DSCP values as Microsoft requirements without the source page
Treat QoS as a substitute for locating packet loss outside controlled networks

scenarios.question: When would you use Call Analytics or the current Teams admin call-troubleshooting experience versus Call Quality Dashboard?
must_not_do: Treat the tools as identical in scope
Use retired Real-Time Analytics pages as current primary authority
Use CQD as an individual live-call debugger

scenarios.question: How do you create and manage standard conference room resources in Exchange or Microsoft 365?
must_not_do: Expand into broad Exchange administration
Treat a normal user mailbox as the preferred room identity
Use interview prep as the configuration source

scenarios.question: A Teams Room account seems to be locked out constantly. How do you investigate using standard Windows or Microsoft 365 tools?
must_not_do: Disable Conditional Access without diagnosis
Treat the room account as an Auto Attendant resource account
Assume smart lockout is the only cause

scenarios.question: How do you approach managing Teams Rooms devices through Intune? Talk about policy configuration or troubleshooting a compliance issue.
must_not_do: Claim identical Windows and Android enrollment paths
Treat Teams admin center Android workflows as future-state authority
Give OEM firmware recovery as Microsoft fact

scenarios.question: How do you create a Teams Rooms resource account and configure calendar processing so the room can accept meetings?
must_not_do: Claim Two Sigma asked this exact wording
Invent unreviewed Exchange parameters
Prefer a user mailbox over a room mailbox

scenarios.question: How would you use the Linux command line to investigate a failed service, including status, processes, and recent logs?
must_not_do: Attribute Linux commands to Microsoft Learn authority
Claim a distribution-specific service name without context
Restart the service as the first diagnostic step
Invent a personal Linux war story

scenarios.question: How would you distinguish bad credentials, smart lockout, and a Conditional Access block when a Windows or resource account cannot sign in?
must_not_do: Reset the password as the first response to every failure
Disable Conditional Access without evidence
Treat this as a Teams Voice routing problem

scenarios.question: How would you identify listening sockets and capture basic network evidence on Linux while diagnosing a UC-related service?
must_not_do: Attribute Linux networking tools to Microsoft documentation
Recommend unbounded packet capture
Claim this exact question was asked by Two Sigma

scenarios.question: How would you use PowerShell to audit Teams Voice users and their voice configuration?
must_not_do: Synthesize an audit workflow that is not in the cmdlet documentation
Treat policy-definition getters as proof of user assignment
Invent cmdlets

scenarios.question: Which Teams PowerShell checks show the voice-routing policy, PSTN usages, voice routes, and gateways used by Direct Routing?
must_not_do: Use write cmdlets in a read-only audit
Claim a definition getter proves effective user assignment
Invent cmdlet parameters

scenarios.question: How would you design a PowerShell or Python script from scratch to identify and remediate a systemic voice-routing misconfiguration?
must_not_do: Invent a personal script you never wrote
Jump to write/remediation before discovery
Treat Microsoft cmdlet pages as a complete automation methodology
Claim Two Sigma asked this exact wording

scenarios.question: Which Teams PowerShell cmdlets inspect resource accounts, Auto Attendants, and Call Queues?
must_not_do: Invent a Teams Rooms reporting cmdlet
Present write operations as required for inspection
Treat preview Teams Phone Agent cmdlets as GA Call Queue facts

scenarios.question: How would you phase a global Teams Voice rollout and reduce risk during a major UC migration?
expected_themes: voice migration or PSTN cutover planning
must_not_do: Let isolated Teams Rooms, Auto Attendant, or SharePoint pages dominate because they mention rollout
Present a tenant-specific Two Sigma architecture as fact
Skip rollback and validation

scenarios.question: How would you prepare SharePoint and OneDrive before rolling out Microsoft 365 Copilot so data is not retrievable by every Copilot user?
expected_themes: Data Access Governance or SharePoint Advanced Management
Restricted Content Discovery or Restricted Access Control
must_not_do: Claim Copilot bypasses permissions
Recommend retiring Restricted SharePoint Search as the new control
Claim Restricted Content Discovery revokes existing access or supports OneDrive

scenarios.question: Have you coordinated number porting with carriers? What is the biggest challenge you have faced?
expected_themes: inventory and FOC or port date
must_not_do: Invent personal porting history
Treat Microsoft documentation as a substitute for the candidate's story
Assert carrier-specific intervals as universal Microsoft fact

scenarios.question: What is the most complex administrative task you automated from scratch? Walk me through identifying the opportunity and building the PowerShell or Python script.
must_not_do: Invent personal automation history
Score Microsoft cmdlet pages as the candidate's story
Skip logging, error handling, or validation
